format: Modern single-letter flags may be concatenated, e.g. HMX. Legacy numeric flags have two digits. Descriptions are never searched for sector keywords.
reason: Higher education must be explicitly reported; nonprofit definitions exclude higher education and are not positive academic evidence. Any individual flag wins for privacy. These mutually exclusive analytic groups are not official program-purpose assignments.
unknown: Unmapped or missing classifications stay Unknown / unclassified.
contract_scope: Contract grouping remains based on explicit reported boolean organization-type flags; the assistance keyword correction is not applied to contract descriptions.

government_levels.basis: FABS government codes split by level: A/00 state (F = U.S. territory or possession), B/C/D/G/01/02/04/05 local governments and school districts, I/J/K/11 tribal governments, L authorities and commissions, E regional organizations. Contracts use the reported boolean organization-type flags for the same levels, plus federal and foreign governments.
government_levels.unknown_inheritance: An unclassified record inherits a sector only when the same UEI reports exactly one sector elsewhere in these archives; conflicting or absent evidence stays unclassified. Counts are recorded in the sector audit.

foreign: W (non-domestic entity) is reported separately as Foreign entities; it is never inferred from names or addresses.
